'''Jamie Davyous Owens''' is an American voice actress who was one of the original voice actresses for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Owens is a professionally trained actress who has done various roles in television ads, radio, webcasts, and New York theatre. Her skills include accents and dialects (including Cockney, Irish, British RP, Southern Scottish and Merenge) and a familiarity with Japanese culture from spending three years in Japan.

Owens joined the series in [[S08|the eighth season]], when she took over the role of Officer Jenny, which was previously done by [[Lee Quick]]. She is succeeded by [[Emily Williams]] when Owens left the series after [[The Pokémon Company International|Pokémon USA]] took over the dubbing and distribution of the {{pkmn|animated series}}.
